test_cases.title: Registered user receives valid reset link for 30 minutes
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user receives a valid reset link valid for 30 minutes.

steps.action: A registered user enters a valid email address in the password reset form.
steps.expected_result: The system generates and sends a password reset link to the email, valid for 30 minutes.

steps.action: The user checks their email within 30 minutes of receiving the reset link.
steps.expected_result: The email contains a valid reset link that can be used to reset the password.

steps.action: The user clicks the reset link within 30 minutes of receiving it.
steps.expected_result: The system redirects to the password reset page, and the link is considered valid and active.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

test_cases.title: Unregistered email receives confirmation but no reset email
test_cases.objective: Verify that an unregistered email receives a visible confirmation message but no reset email is sent.

steps.action: A user submits an unregistered email address in the password reset form.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a visible confirmation message to the user, indicating that a reset link was attempted.

steps.action: The system does not send an email to the unregistered address.
steps.expected_result: No email is sent to the unregistered email address.

steps.action: The user checks their inbox after submission.
steps.expected_result: No reset email is found in the inbox.

source_requirements: An unregistered email address receives the same visible confirmation, but no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset link is used only once
test_cases.objective: Verify that a reset link can be used only once.

steps.action: A registered user submits their email and receives a reset link.
steps.expected_result: The system generates a one-time-use reset link valid for 30 minutes.

steps.action: The user clicks the reset link to change their password.
steps.expected_result: The password is successfully reset, and the link is invalidated.

steps.action: The user attempts to use the same link again.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the link is invalid or expired.

source_requirements: A reset link can be used only once.

test_cases.title: Invalid email input results in error and no reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that invalid input (e.g., empty or malformed email) results in an error message and no reset link is generated.

steps.action: A user submits an empty email field or a malformed email (e.g., 'invalid-email') in the password reset form.
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating invalid email format or field is empty.

steps.action: The system does not generate or send a reset link.
steps.expected_result: No reset link is created or sent to any address.

steps.action: The user attempts to proceed without correcting the input.
steps.expected_result: The form remains in an error state, and no reset link is generated.

test_cases.title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes
test_cases.objective: Verify that the reset link expires after exactly 30 minutes, even if used later.

steps.action: A registered user submits their email and receives a reset link.
steps.expected_result: The system generates a reset link valid for 30 minutes from the time of generation.

steps.action: The user waits exactly 30 minutes and then attempts to use the link.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the link and displays an error message indicating it has expired.

steps.action: The user attempts to use the link after 31 minutes.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the request and indicates the link is expired.

source_requirements: A reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

test_cases.title: New password must satisfy configured policy
test_cases.objective: Verify that the new password must satisfy the configured password policy.

steps.action: A user receives a reset link and clicks it to change their password.
steps.expected_result: The system redirects to the password reset page.

steps.action: The user enters a password that violates the configured policy (e.g., less than 8 characters, no special character).
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the password and displays an error message indicating policy violation.

steps.action: The user enters a password that meets the configured policy (e.g., 8+ characters, includes uppercase, lowercase, number, special character).
steps.expected_result: The system accepts the password and updates the account successfully.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the configured password policy.
